name: Wattson
tagline: A virtual pet that sickens when you leave the lights on and thrives when you save power.
problem: People waste electricity by leaving lights on.
solution: A sensor board detects light; leaving lights on too long hurts the pet, saving power earns points for cosmetics in a shop.
demo_moment: Team-described: leave the light on and watch the pet's health drop.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “MHacks Greenprint Winner” and “Best Use of FREE-WiLi” among 122 submissions.
Turns a dull habit into care for a character.

lessons: Attach a habit to a character people do not want to hurt.
